$comment: Hand-authored source of truth for test traceability. See docs/test-traceability-reports/README.md. The generator and the pytest collection hook both validate against this file; an unknown flow or category is a hard error, never a silently dropped row.
$expectations: Categories a flow is expected to carry, by severity and by surface. Reported as gaps, never failed — a missing safety test is a conversation, not a broken build.

severities.P0: A failure here fabricates an attribution or citation, or makes the system produce imagery it must never produce.
severities.P1: A failure here gives the artist wrong analysis, but the artist is looking at their own work and can see it.
severities.P2: A failure here degrades the experience without misinforming anyone.

flows.title: Acknowledgement gate, sign-in, and the route guard
flows.rationale: Two independent gates in a fixed order. Reorder them and every visitor lands somewhere wrong, silently — the gate chain is snapshot-tested for exactly that reason.

flows.title: App shell, navigation, theming, and localization
flows.rationale: The chrome every surface renders identically. Regressions here are wide but shallow, and a11y lives here.

flows.title: Shared schemas and the TS/Python contract boundary
flows.rationale: A drifted contract fails at the seam between the apps and the agent layer, where neither side's tests look.

flows.title: Agent service transport, auth guard, and graph execution
flows.rationale: The seam every studio feature runs through: a forwarded Supabase token verified at the edge, and a compiled LangGraph behind it. Two failures live here and are invisible from either side alone — a run whose owner comes from the request body rather than the verified token, and a graph whose accumulating state silently overwrites instead of appending, which is what makes a resumed run unreadable.

flows.title: Upload, intake, and the typed ProjectIntent
flows.rationale: Medium and time budget drive tool selection, so a mis-parsed intent misroutes the whole run. The artist stated these values and can see them, which keeps it below the analysis flows — but the untrusted surfaces arrive here too: EXIF, filename, and the free-text goal are screened at ingest, never interpreted as instruction (FR-106).

flows.title: Head construction, perspective, confidence, and artist correction
flows.rationale: The two Tier B tools carry per-feature confidence, and below threshold the graph interrupts rather than guessing (FR-401/402). Two failures live here and look alike from outside: a low-confidence landmark asserted anyway, and a stale study surviving a correction that should have recomputed it (FR-404).

flows.title: Structural analysis of a supplied work
flows.rationale: The vision pass. Generic praise instead of compositional geometry, tonal distribution, and colour relationships is the failure mode the prompt constraints exist to prevent.

flows.title: Critique of execution against the artist's stated goal
flows.rationale: The judgement that makes the critique worth reading. It must engage the artist's actual intent, not substitute a generic ideal.

flows.title: The system refuses to generate imagery
flows.rationale: The authorship and copyright commitment the whole design rests on. A regression here is silent by construction and would not look like a bug.

flows.title: Art-historical context is carried back to a real citation
flows.rationale: A confident, ungrounded attribution is the confabulation failure mode this project exists to prevent.

flows.title: Palette, value study, and edge-map extraction
flows.rationale: Deterministic CV, not model output. It either reproduces exactly or it has broken.

flows.title: Canvas match, compositional grids, and the studio prep kit
flows.rationale: Geometry the artist acts on physically. A wrong aspect ratio wastes a real canvas.

flows.title: Cost, latency, evaluation health, and corpus ingestion
flows.rationale: An internal surface. A wrong number here misleads the operator, not the artist.
